text:
hana: Quick sweep notes for /insights after today's QA: keyboard halo can disappear on focused rows, legend swatches aren't announced by screen readers, and one hidden link is tabbable.

omar: Repro on mac/chrome: tab into table -> use arrow keys -> focus appears then vanishes when row is recycled. Looks like virtualization + focus on the cell causes unmount.

leah: For the ring, swapping from outline -> box-shadow on a non-recycled ancestor (.row-shell) fixed clipping for me. Add forced-colors fallback so high-contrast users still see it.

ben: Chart voice issues: svg has no accessible name and legend swatches are decorative spans. Add role="img" plus aria-labelledby on the figure and give each legend item a clear aria-label like "Errors — red". Ensure DOM order matches visual order.

a11y-bot: Axe snapshot (2028-01-05): fail - focusable hidden element; fail - svg missing accessible name; warn - selected-row contrast below 4.5:1 in light theme.

hana: Action list: omar -> open ticket with repro + screenshots; leah -> PR to move focus ring to .row-shell + forced-colors rule + prefers-reduced-motion guard; ben -> update chart markup and run VoiceOver/Narrator checks; everyone -> check for tabbable hidden anchors and set tabindex=-1/aria-hidden.

omar: Filed INF-6220, attached quick Playwright snippet to smoke test tabbing and an example VoiceOver transcript.

leah: I'll include a small Playwright test that tabs through rows, opens the inline menu, Shift+Tabs back and asserts focus returns to the row.

ben: Also propose switching selected-row label color to blue-650 to meet 4.5:1 on #F2F7FF; adding that token change to the PR.

hana: Thanks! Please link INF-6220 in PR descriptions and add browser/version matrix.
